text: The cause is of three kinds, due to the difference between *samavayya* and *samavayyinimitta*. The cause that produces a result which is *samavayya* (co-occurring) is the *samavayika* cause. For example, the thread is the cause of the cloth. And the cloth is the cause of its own form etc. When there is co-occurrence in one purpose with the result or the cause, then the cause is the *asamavayika* cause. For example, the joining of threads is the cause of the cloth. The form of the thread is the cause of the form of the cloth. The cause that is different from both of them is the *nimitta* cause. For example, the needle is the cause of the cloth. Among these three types of causes, whatever is the uncommon cause is the instrument. || 37 ||
